name: Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards
tagline: Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards at https://scottsfarms.com/
description: In 274 Kelsey Hill Road, CT, Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
